reviews.summary: No changes were needed. src/screens/net/NetHeader.tsx already has no onInfo prop: its props are { line, glow, place?, onClear?, info?: ComponentChildren }. The file has no reference to onInfo, setInfo, Sheet or InfoIcon, and no caller in src passes onInfo. The component still renders the info slot through the `info` children prop, so it works without the removed prop. Nothing is staged, so no new or orphaned files were added. The builder could not run tests because Bash permission was denied, but the harness test result reports passed (ctr-C001).
